config.hypothesis: If the correct answer appears in a sampled candidate set, verifier reranking will outperform a single-answer baseline; adaptive reranking will retain most of the gain while using fewer samples than fixed reranking.
config.research_question: Can verifier-guided test-time compute improve answer accuracy over a single generation while making the extra sample cost explicit?
config.title: Verifier-Guided Test-Time Compute on Bounded QA
